question: M.S. Gopalakrishnan mastered both Carnatic and Hindustani Classical music. He was a _________ maestro.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Violin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **M.S. Gopalakrishnan**, sometimes known as **MSG**, was a Carnatic musician who lived from 10 June 1931 to 3 January 2013.
 
• In Carnatic music, he is frequently classified as part of the **violin **trio alongside **Lalgudi Jayaraman **and **T.N. Krishnan**.
 
• He was presented with the **Padma Bhushan** award in **2012** and Padma Shri in 1975 for his excellency in Indian classical music.
 
• He was also awarded the **Madras Music Academy’s Sangeetha Kalanidhi in 1997,** the Padma Shri Kalaimamani and Sangeet Natak Akademi awards, among others.
